A '''clan''' of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They were allied with the Empire and sought the [[Sword of the First]]&mdash;a lost dueling blade that belonged to the clan's [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan's founder|founder]]. The clan hired treasure hunters to locate it, and they found it buried in the skull of a large beast skeleton that had eaten the clan's founder.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Sword of the First}}</ref>
